jobs.title: Pediatric Nurse Practitioner for The Center for Autism Services, Science and Innovation (CASSI): Greenspring Location
Nurse Practitioner Opening, New Kent, VA

notes: Mid-Atlantic gap pass, 38 of 40 web calls. LifeBridge's Talemetry board rendered (22 NP/APP results, none pediatric); Kennedy Krieger's iCIMS board is JS-rendered but posting pages fetch fine and carry 3+ open PNP roles; the ChristianaCare 'NP, Pediatric Hospitalist, Elkton MD' (JR76729) is closed on the employer and aggregator copies; HCA Virginia's careers.hcahealthcare.com was searched on-domain for all 7 facilities with no NP/APP postings found (only RN roles); six boards (MWPH Entertime, Howard, HSC now on Children's National Workday, Frederick UKG, Meritus UKG, Chesapeake UKG) could not be read by any pass.

url_fixes.why: Kennedy Krieger uses iCIMS (jobs-kennedykrieger.icims.com). The search page is JS-rendered for WebFetch but the engine's icims adapter should read it; posting pages /jobs/<id>/<slug>/job render server side.
mwph.org/jobs links 'View our current job openings' to this Entertime Online (Kronos/UKG Ready) applicant portal; robots.txt refuses WebFetch so the engine needs a browser-based read.

hschealth.org/careers/job-openings now 302-redirects to childrensnational.org/get-care/departments/rehabilitation-specialized-care; its careers page links all openings to the Children's National Workday board (CN_Careers). HSC jobs post there; filter by location/department 'HSC Pediatric Center' or 'Rehabilitation & Specialized Care'. Engine: workday adapter.

frederickhealth.org/about/careers/ (HTTP 200, while /careers is 403) links current openings to this UKG/UltiPro job board; set careers_platform=ultipro with board_path /FRE1010FRHS/JobBoard/776a147e-2e0b-43d0-844e-bbd49deeb24d.

The ultipro adapter needs board_path /MER1012MERH/JobBoard/23a054d5-dd9d-4a01-ba62-0bc75b4673d6 (already seen in careers_notes). WebFetch of the board returns the 'unsupported browser' shell, so it needs the engine's browser read.

chesapeakeregional.com/careers/job-board embeds a UKG Pro Recruiting board (company code CHE1503CHPE, JobBoard GUID 09584b08-b32f-4882-8c7b-223bbd8e3851) on the rec.pro.ukg.net host rather than recruiting.ultipro.com; the ultipro adapter needs that board_path and host.

ChristianaCare jobs live on Workday tenant christianacare.wd5 (site CCHS); careers.christianacare.org/posting/<JR id>/ is a front-end that returned a client error on fetch. Engine: workday adapter, filter location Elkton / Union Hospital.

huhealthcare.com/careers is 403; search points to healthsciences.howard.edu/about-huhs/careers as the hospital careers page, but it is robots-disallowed for WebFetch, so the ATS behind it is still unknown. Needs a browser probe.

cumberlandhospital.com/careers is 403; the hospital's provider postings are on the UHS iCIMS board (careers-universalhealthservices.icims.com), where posting pages render server side. Engine: icims adapter, keyword 'New Kent' or 'Cumberland'.
